blurb: Guests can join for wine tastings from 10am to 2pm and enjoy woodfired pizza and drinks on the patio from 2pm to 8pm. The venue hosts live music events regularly, including a Friday night series called Live in the Vineyard. Walk-in tastings are available with no reservation required, but booking ahead is possible to guarantee a spot.
